fields.name: Bruno
fields.description: Bruno is a cheerful and energetic Golden Retriever who loves outdoor adventures and cuddles. He is fully vaccinated, house-trained, and gets along perfectly with children and other pets.

fields.name: Luna
fields.description: Luna is a playful and gentle Labrador Retriever pup. She is very sociable, loves water, and is already learning her first commands. Perfect for active families.

fields.name: Max
fields.description: Max is a trained German Shepherd with excellent guarding instincts. He responds to basic commands and is loyal, protective, and loving with his family.

fields.name: Bella
fields.description: Bella is an adorable Pomeranian puppy with a fluffy double coat. She is lively, curious, and loves being the centre of attention. Ideal for apartment living.

fields.name: Rocky
fields.description: Rocky is a confident and well-socialized Rottweiler. He has been raised with children and is protective yet gentle with his family. A true gentle giant.

fields.name: Daisy
fields.description: Daisy is a merry little Beagle with an irresistible nose. She loves sniffing adventures in the park and is great with kids and other dogs.

fields.name: Coco
fields.description: Coco is a feisty and loyal Chihuahua who thinks she is much bigger than she is! She is perfect for apartment living and loves snuggling under blankets.

fields.name: Duke
fields.description: Duke is a striking Siberian Husky with piercing blue eyes. He is adventurous, playful, and loves cold weather. Needs daily exercise and a committed owner.

fields.name: Milo
fields.description: Milo is a bat-eared French Bulldog with loads of personality packed into a small body. He is adaptable, low-energy, and perfect for city life.

fields.name: Maggie
fields.description: Maggie is an incredibly intelligent Border Collie who thrives on mental stimulation. She knows 20+ commands and loves agility training. She needs an experienced owner.

fields.name: Buddy
fields.description: Buddy is a sweet Golden Retriever puppy who loves everyone he meets. He is growing fast and will be a wonderful family companion for years to come.

fields.name: Pepper
fields.description: Pepper is a curious and mischievous Dachshund who can follow a scent anywhere. He is stubborn but very lovable and keeps everyone entertained.

fields.name: Whiskers
fields.description: Whiskers is a regal Persian with a luxurious white coat. She is calm, quiet, and loves being groomed and pampered. Perfect for a serene home environment.

fields.name: Simba
fields.description: Simba is a talkative and social Siamese who will follow you from room to room. He is incredibly intelligent and thrives on interaction and play.

fields.name: Mittens
fields.description: Mittens is a majestic Maine Coon with tufted ears and a magnificent plumed tail. She is dog-like in her loyalty and loves to play fetch.

fields.name: Shadow
fields.description: Shadow is a sleek and glossy Bombay with copper-penny eyes. He is curious and playful, often described as a miniature panther who loves cuddles.

fields.name: Lily
fields.description: Lily is a floppy, easy-going Ragdoll who goes limp when picked up. She is placid, affectionate, and absolutely perfect for families with children.

fields.name: Oliver
fields.description: Oliver is a plush British Shorthair with the most gorgeous blue-grey coat. He is independent but affectionate on his own terms ù a true British gentleman.

fields.name: Cleo
fields.description: Cleo is an active and curious Abyssinian who is always on the move. She loves to climb, explore, and play. She will keep you entertained all day.

fields.name: Nala
fields.description: Nala is a gentle and loyal Russian Blue who bonds deeply with one person. She is shy at first but incredibly affectionate once she trusts you.

fields.name: Patches
fields.description: Patches is a sweet 3-year-old rescue who has been through a lot but has so much love to give. She is gentle, house-trained, and ready for her forever home.

fields.name: Tom
fields.description: Tom is a classic tabby with a laid-back personality. He is great with other cats and children, and he just needs a warm home to call his own.

fields.name: Rio
fields.description: Rio is a remarkable African Grey with an impressive vocabulary of 150+ words. He loves music, puzzles, and learning new tricks. A truly extraordinary companion.

fields.name: Tweety
fields.description: Tweety is a cheerful budgie who loves to chirp and chatter all day. She is easy to tame and will quickly learn to sit on your finger.

fields.name: Peaches
fields.description: Peaches is a gentle cockatiel who can whistle tunes and loves gentle head scratches. She is perfect for first-time bird owners.

fields.name: Kiwi
fields.description: Kiwi is a brilliantly coloured Sun Conure who is bold, cuddly, and loves being the star of every room. He will form an intense bond with his owner.

fields.name: Sunny
fields.description: Sunny fills the room with beautiful singing every morning. He is low-maintenance and perfect for someone who appreciates birdsong without the fuss.

fields.name: Polly
fields.description: Polly is a sharp and independent Indian Ringneck who is learning to talk. She is stunning in flight and loves foraging for treats.

fields.name: Goldie
fields.description: Goldie is a lively common goldfish, brightest in the room. She comes with starter care instructions and thrives in a basic tank setup.

fields.name: Neptune
fields.description: Neptune is a stunning Betta fish with flowing fins that shimmer like a jewel. Keep him solo in a well-planted tank for best results.

fields.name: Nemo
fields.description: Just like the movie, Nemo is adventurous and striking. He does well with anemones in a saltwater reef setup. A real crowd-pleaser.

fields.name: Coral
fields.description: Coral is a hardy and colourful guppy, ideal for community tanks. She is one of the best beginner fish. Available as a pair or trio.

fields.name: Dory
fields.description: Dory is a striking Blue Tang who commands attention in any saltwater aquarium. She needs space to swim and a well-established reef tank.

fields.name: Zigzag
fields.description: Zigzag and his school of Neon Tetras are sold as a group of 10. They create a dazzling display in any planted freshwater aquarium.

fields.name: Hopscotch
fields.description: Hopscotch is an adorable Mini Lop with floppy ears and a round, cuddly body. She loves hopping around and exploring. Indoor litter-trained.

fields.name: Snowball
fields.description: Snowball is a fluffy Angora who looks like a cloud. His wool coat needs regular grooming, but the result is absolutely stunning. Very calm temperament.

fields.name: Thumper
fields.description: Thumper is a playful Harlequin rabbit with a distinctive patchwork coat. He is curious, active, and loves chin rubs. Great for older children.

fields.name: Cottonbud
fields.description: Cottonbud is a beautiful Rex rabbit who was surrendered by her previous owner. She is spayed, vaccinated, and very friendly. Looking for a forever home.
